prompts.title: Quote by square foot
prompts.summary: Prices by surface and square foot, with a minimum and a soft wash line.
prompts.prompt: Build a pressure washing price sheet for [business]. Target per hour [$]. Rates by surface: concrete [$/sq ft], wood deck [ ], house soft wash by stories [ ], roof [ ], gutters [ ]. Minimum job [$]. Give a menu and a text I send with a quote from a customer's photos.
prompts.use: Ask for photos and rough size before you drive out.

prompts.title: Half-clean reel
prompts.summary: The 15-second reel with the clean line through the dirt.
prompts.prompt: Write a 15-second reel brief for a [surface] at [business]: the first second (the clean line), the sound, three shots, the reveal, on-screen words (six at most) and a caption with the town and price range.
prompts.use: Film every job. Post the best one each week.

prompts.title: Neighbor flyer
prompts.summary: A short flyer for the street you're working on.
prompts.prompt: Write a flyer for [business] to leave on the street where we just washed [house, only with the owner's OK]. 50 words at most: what we did, a price for the same job, how to book, and our name, phone and address. No discount pressure.
prompts.use: Leave them the same day. Ask the owner first.
